Summary
The Abdullah I invasion of Anatolia was a major military campaign led by Abdullah I against the Sok Shia forces in the region of Anatolia.
The Campaign
The invasion resulted in a total collapse of the opposition's defenses. During the final stages of the conflict, Sami I officially surrendered, while Majid alhilali was captured and executed by the victorious forces.
Aftermath
The conflict ended with a staggering death toll of 60,000 killed from the defending side, marking one of the most violent episodes in the campaign's history.
